definitions.explanation: a wall or barrier built for protection or defense, used both literally and figuratively

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{防壁|ぼうへき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{築|きず}かれた→築く：02046_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: A defensive wall was built around the castle.

examples.japanese: ⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{防壁|ぼうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}する→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
examples.english: To strengthen the barrier against viruses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{異文化|いぶんか}→異文化：15703_ibunka⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{防壁|ぼうへき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The language barrier has become a major obstacle to cross-cultural understanding.

notes:
A wall or barrier constructed for defensive purposes. Used literally for physical fortifications and figuratively for anything that serves as a protective or obstructive barrier. More formal and literary than the everyday word ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防壁|ぼうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧: to build a defensive wall
- {防壁|ぼうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break through a barrier
- {防壁|ぼうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}する→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧: to strengthen a barrier

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧: wall — general everyday word for any wall
- ⟦{城壁|じょうへき}→城壁：21582_jouheki⟧: castle wall — specifically fortification walls of a castle
- ⟦{障壁|しょうへき}→障壁：14536_shouheki⟧: barrier/obstacle — emphasizes the obstructive quality, often used figuratively for trade barriers and the like
- ⟦{堤防|ていぼう}→堤防：19409_teibou⟧: embankment/levee — specifically for flood protection
